name: Desert Ant Labs social card by Desert Ant Labs
description: A roughly 1200×630 off-white social card uses a sparse, left-anchored composition with generous negative space. A small black rounded-square mark sits in the upper-left, while the focal headline occupies the lower-left in two oversized lines: the first has a soft grainy texture and the second is crisp, heavy black type; a small monospaced URL provides a quiet footer detail.
